title: Zip the Webroot
description: Zip the webroot for the security review while excluding debug logs from the archive.
scenario: The security review team wants a copy of the webroot at /var/www/html — but policy forbids shipping log files, and a stray debug.log is sitting in the directory. Create /home/intern/webroot.zip with zip, excluding any *.log file, then verify with unzip -l that the site pages are in and the log is not.
symptoms: /var/www/html contains index.html, about.html, assets/ — and a debug.log that must NOT ship
The review portal only accepts .zip archives
The previous attempt included the log and was rejected by the reviewers
mission: Create /home/intern/webroot.zip from /var/www/html excluding *.log files, and verify the archive lists index.html but no debug.log.

hints.title: Recursive zip
hints.content: `zip -r out.zip dir` descends into subdirectories. Run it from /var/www so the entries are named html/… instead of carrying the full absolute path.

hints.title: Exclude patterns
hints.content: `-x "*.log"` drops every entry whose path ends in .log — the pattern matches against the names INSIDE the archive.

hints.title: Verify with unzip -l
hints.content: `unzip -l` lists the archive; grep the listing for index.html (must match) and debug.log (must not).

acceptance_criteria.description: the file is a valid zip archive
the archive does NOT contain debug.log
